reviews.title: Runs cooler and uses less power than I thought
reviews.comment: In Windows 11 Pro for Workstations it’s running 41C and using ~76W to 87W power at idle.  I have the Silverstone AIO water cooler.  When torture testing with Prime95 it hits around 95C and uses about 500W of power, although I have not optimized the fan speeds yet and I think I can get the temp lower at high load.  Also this is with some Asus EXPO and AI overclocking settings applied.  What I found impressive is that applications multitasking runs smooth even with Prime95 running full blast.  That would bog down a non-Threadripper PRO system with fewer cores.
reviews.author: D. Coral
